source: Kaggle dataset 'E-Commerce Data' by Ben Roshan ('Sales details from Indian e-commerce website'). Downloaded via Kaggle's public (anonymous) dataset-download endpoint - CC0, no login/token used.
country_context: India - a single online retailer (Furniture / Clothing / Electronics), Apr 2018 - Mar 2019.
business_domain: E-commerce retail orders + line items + monthly category targets
provenance: UNVERIFIED. The Kaggle uploader states: 'Dataset received from my University, Original Author unknown.' Treated as real Indian retail data with this caveat; not used to make strong population claims.
license: CC0: Public Domain (per the Kaggle dataset page)
citation: Ben Roshan. E-Commerce Data [Data set]. Kaggle. https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/benroshan/ecommerce-data (CC0).
original_files: List of Orders.csv (500 orders after dropping 60 trailing blank rows)

derived_fields.price (forecasting frame): implied unit price = daily revenue / daily units, forward/back-filled. DERIVED and documented - there is no unit-price field in the source.
derived_fields.marketing_spend / promotion_flag: held at 0 - absent in source, not invented
derived_fields.attainment_pct: monthly actual revenue / the dataset's own Target

unsupported_tasks: unit-price / elasticity pricing analysis (only line Amount, not unit price)
churn / customer analytics (customers are names, not identified; single-year snapshot)
preprocessing: ml/preprocessing/india_ecommerce_adapter.py (seed 42): drop trailing blank rows + full-row dups; join orders + line items; dayfirst date parse; daily zero-fill for the forecasting series; chronological split via the existing pipeline.
known_limitations: Small: ~500 orders over 12 months, 3 product categories.
Profit values are volatile (large per-line losses) - inspect before drawing margin conclusions.
No unit price/discount -> pricing scenarios are limited; forecasting benchmark is small and high-variance.
paper_usage: Table 1 (predictive performance) - small real Indian forecasting benchmark, labelled INDIA_REAL_BUSINESS, reported separately from synthetic. Primarily used for descriptive Indian retail analytics. Never merged with AGMARKNET (agri price) or synthetic metrics.
